title: Surviving the Dry Season: A Lion's Search for Water

scenes.heading: A landscape under pressure
scenes.caption: The dry season reshapes the savanna
scenes.narration: Across the African savanna, the dry season transforms the landscape. Grass fades to gold, streams shrink into isolated pools, and the distance between reliable sources of water grows. Every animal must adjust its daily routine to survive.
scenes.visual_beat: Heat haze and moving grass establish scale.

scenes.heading: Following a familiar route
scenes.caption: Experience guides the search for water
scenes.narration: A mature lion does not search at random. It travels through a familiar territory, following routes shaped by memory, scent and the movements of other animals. The journey is measured and economical, because wasting energy in extreme heat can become dangerous.
scenes.visual_beat: The lion advances across layered grassland.

scenes.heading: A waterhole appears
scenes.caption: A small pool attracts many animals
scenes.narration: At last, a remaining waterhole comes into view. The lion slows and studies the surroundings before approaching. A water source can draw several species together, making it valuable but also unpredictable. Careful attention matters before the first drink.
scenes.visual_beat: The lion pauses; distant birds circle above the pool.

scenes.heading: Drinking in measured laps
scenes.caption: Each lap sends ripples across the pool
scenes.narration: The lion lowers its head to the surface and begins to drink. Its tongue curls water into the mouth in repeated laps. Small ripples spread across the pool, breaking the reflection of the bright sky. For a moment, the animal's attention is focused entirely on drinking.
scenes.visual_beat: Tongue movement, droplets and expanding ripples.

scenes.heading: A pause to recover
scenes.caption: Rest conserves energy in the midday heat
scenes.narration: After drinking, the lion raises its head and remains still for a moment. Its ears turn toward sounds in the grass while the body settles. During the hottest hours, resting in shade and avoiding unnecessary movement helps conserve energy for the challenges ahead.
scenes.visual_beat: The lion listens; a distant rival remains in silhouette.

scenes.heading: The journey continues
scenes.caption: Survival depends on adapting to change
scenes.narration: The waterhole is only one part of survival. The lion eventually moves on, leaving the pool to the other animals. As the seasons shift, it must keep finding food, shelter and safe routes through a landscape that never stays the same.
scenes.visual_beat: The lion departs into a wide, sunlit landscape.
